overall: Atlanta is at 71.6°F as of 10:20 ET with a warming rate of +1.8°F/hr, tracking a fairly typical early-June heating curve. The day is not running notably hot or cold relative to model expectations at this hour — progress from 66.2°F at 07:00 to 71.6°F by 10:15 is consistent with a mid-80s afternoon high.
forecast_obs_notes: The four major NWP models show unusually tight agreement, clustering between 83.8°F (ECMWF) and 85.4°F (GFS/HRRR), a spread of only ~1.6°F — a signal of relatively high forecast confidence.
